name: Non Mendelian Inheritance: Imprinting, Repeats and Mitochondria

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Differential methylation marks gametes so only one parental allele transcribes; slippage expands repeats into toxic RNA or polyglutamine, and bottleneck segregation shuffles mutant mitochondria into tissues randomly.
